column1: # CI gates, one row per gate in execution order; scripts/ci-verify.sh runs them.
# Under ci-verify.sh --jobs the order is the start priority, so gates on the
# critical path (the bootstrap and the long gates after it) come first.
# hosts: all, linux or windows. label: the display and ci-timing gate name.
# needs: - or earlier gate IDs whose outputs this gate uses (id@host limits an
# edge to one host); ci-verify.sh --gates runs the closure of these edges.
# compiler: the TYPELISP_BIN the command sees: - (a path that cannot exist),
# stage2 (the converged bootstrap compiler) or profile (the compile-profile CLI).
# memory: MiB reserved while the gate runs, its measured Linux process-tree peak
# plus about a quarter, rounded up to 256; ci-verify.sh --jobs admits by it.
# locks: - or shared checkout paths (scripts/README.md) no two running gates
# command: shell text evaluated in the checkout root; gate_* names a function in
